report_title: FY26 Annual Results (web-derived; Appendix 4E / annual report PDF not retrieved)
notes: Production from Karlawinda only. AISC in AUD converted to USD at assumed FY26 average AUD:USD 0.65 (approximate; FX rate not stated in sourced material). Executive Chairman Mark Clark. FY26: sales revenue A$769.3M (123,096 oz @ A$6,241/oz), underlying EBITDA A$483.6M, NPAT A$282.2M, debt-free and unhedged, net cash A$504.8M, maiden dividend A$0.10/share. Range 500 aspiration: 500 koz pa within 5 years. FY27 guidance: 137,000-147,000 oz @ A$1,900-2,100/oz AISC.

mines.processing: Karlawinda processing plant (4 Mtpa, expanding to 6.5 Mtpa via Karlawinda Expansion Project; commissioning Q1 FY27, expansion completed on schedule Sep 2026)
mines.mine_notes: WA. Record FY26 production at top end of 115,000-125,000 oz guidance; FY26 AISC A$1,629/oz converted at 0.65. Karlawinda ORE 1.57 Moz (+32% YoY net of depletion, 27 Jul 2026 announcement). Expansion to 150 koz pa run rate.

WA. Acquired Nov 2025 from Avoca Resources. Updated PFS (Jul 2026): steady-state 260 koz pa from concurrent UG+OP mining, 19.25-year mine life, avg 190 koz pa over 18 years, LOM AISC A$1,870/oz (USD shown at 0.65; PFS-stage AISC estimate), 14-month pretax payback. Maiden UG reserve 0.37 Moz. Federal environmental approval Jun 2026; state environmental review in progress. ORE 3.31 Moz (OP) + 0.37 Moz (UG). No FY26 production.
